# OSTEOMYELITIS WITH PSEUDOMONAS AERUGINOSA

---

References:

- Sanford keyword: Osteomyelitis
- Mandell chapter: Osteomyelitis
- Lew DP Lancet 2004, 364: 369
- Cunha BA Clin Infect Dis 2002, 35: 287
Inpt: ORZID2 GMENU OSTEOM WITH P. AERUGINOSA
Therapy:
## Inpatient

### Treatment

Piperacilin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q6h ($$) [R] <OR>
Ciprofloxacin 400 mg IV q8h ($) [R,DI] <OR>
Ciprofloxacin 750 mg PO q12h ($) [R,DI]

## Outpatient

### Treatment

Ciprofloxacin 750 mg PO BID ($) [R,DI]
